description: Implementation of DropdownReadPlatformService that provides options for various enum types used in the application, such as period frequency, condition types, days in month/year types.

classes.name: DropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that provides dropdown options for various enum types used in financial calculations and settings.

methods.name: retrievePeriodFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData representing different period frequency options (days, weeks, months, years, whole term).

methods.name: retrieveConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData for different condition types (equal, not equal, greater than, less than).

methods.name: retrieveDaysInMonthTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for days in month types, such as actual days and 30 days standard.

methods.name: retrieveDaysInYearTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for days in year types, including actual days, 360 days, 364 days, and 365 days.
